snippet.title: Space Memory: Predators Trailer
snippet.description:
This game on Steam store: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3860200/Space_Memory_Predators/

Space Memory: Predators - is a cute and calming game featuring pictures of cool predators in space. This game will test your memory as you try to find matching pairs of predators pictures to complete each level.

Enjoy the charming atmosphere and improve your memory as the levels become increasingly challenging and exciting.

In Space Memory: Predators:

•50 levels
•Beautiful space art
•Simple controls (mouse)
•Achievements
•Relaxing music
